protocol.batch_fallback: Use each accepted method's frozen fallback; MiniLM uses its new-method fallback; log every OOM/retry and final batch.
protocol.comparability: Compare timing only within the unified rerun; report representation bytes stratified by paradigm without synthetic normalization.
protocol.encoding_trials: One complete document encoding and one complete query encoding per method-track, timed separately after warmup.

hardware.device: cuda:0 for neural methods; same host CPU for lexical methods

protocol.network: Zero during measured runs; all snapshots local-only.
protocol.process_isolation: Fresh process per method; one track at a time; no concurrent benchmark workload on cuda:0.
protocol.scope: Remeasure all 14 methods on both tracks; historical resource figures remain contextual anchors.
protocol.search_trials: Three complete ordered query sweeps per method-track; report each trial and median throughput plus pooled P50/P95/P99 per-query latency.
protocol.warmup: Run the frozen synthetic 1-query/4-document gate once before measured work; run one unrecorded query search before each measured search series.
